sundayReview.body: See how the week went. No grade, just patterns.

weighIn.title: A data point?
weighIn.body: The trend counts, not the single number. One weigh-in is enough.

taktChance.body: One session puts you in rhythm this week.

early.title: All good?
early.body: If you like: one entry is enough to get back in.

mid.title: We’re here when you are
mid.body: One entry, nothing more is needed.

late.title: Drop by for a second?
late.body: Your history is still here. One entry is enough to get back in.

monthReview.title: Your {{month}} has a character
monthReview.body: Take a look at what the month looked like.

settings.title: Notifications
settings.mealRemindersHint: Three fixed prompts for breakfast, lunch and dinner.
settings.permissionOff: Notifications are turned off for møni. You can allow them in Settings.
settings.masterHint: At most one a day, never before 8 am, never after 9:30 pm. Off any time.
settings.explainer: møni only reaches out when it helps: a review that’s ready, a hint after training. If you don’t open them, you get fewer automatically.

sections.categories: What you want to hear about

categoryHint.meals: An evening hint if the day is still empty.
categoryHint.training: Training-day morning and protein after a session.
categoryHint.reviews: Weekly and monthly review when it’s ready.
categoryHint.rhythm: A chance within reach, or an open door after a break.
categoryHint.weight: A weekly nudge for your data point.

settings.quietModeHint: Pauses all notifications until the chosen day.
settings.quietHoursHint: You can only narrow the window: 8:00 to 21:30 is the limit.
settings.footer: Meal reminders are independent of this and off by default.

primer.title: A heads-up for your review?
primer.body: You get a notification when your review is ready. At most one a day, off any time.
